crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses in Mount Sinai,
“ ‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.
One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own…
Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

translations.web: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
translations.bsb: You are observing special days and months and seasons and years!
translations.kjv: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
translations.asv: Ye observe days, and months, and seasons, and years.
